scope: Corollary 3.34 (The contraction step over a lower-dimensional base) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 55. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Use the hypotheses and notation of Proposition 3.30. Suppose that A = f∗γ is nef and that its restriction to the original non-klt closed subspace No = V (Jo) is endowed with a Moishezon contraction. Put I = f∗J1, N∗ = V (I) ⊂ Z. Then γ|N∗ is endowed with a Moishezon contraction. If the prepared non-klt closed subspace N1 = V (J1) dominates Z, then γ and A are endowed with Moishezon contractions. Otherwise the generalized pair supplied on Z has a non-klt closed subspace endowed with the contraction defined by the restricted class of γ. In this latter case, if γ is nef and NQC and the assertion Cdim Z is available, then γ and A are endowed with Moishezon contractions.
